result.instructions: Tools for ImageKit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find all product images in the /products folder that have the tag sale."; "Add the tag summer-2026 to these three file ids."; "Upload this image from its public URL into /banners and tag it homepage.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ImageKit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run imagekit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run imagekit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run imagekit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. imagekit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: imagekit_list_files
tools.title: List or search media files
tools.description: List or search files and folders in the media library, with name, path, tags, size, dimensions and URLs. Use searchQuery for filters such as name, tags or path (for example: 'tags IN ["sale"] AND createdAt > "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"'). ImageKit API: GET /v1/files.

searchQuery.description: ImageKit search query, for example 'name = "shoe.jpg"' or 'tags IN ["sale"]'.

path.description: Only files in this folder path, for example "/products/".

fileType.description: Only images or only non-image files.

sort.description: Sort order. DESC_RELEVANCE suits HAS full-text searches.

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

tools.name: imagekit_get_file
tools.title: Get file details
tools.description: Get one file or folder: name, path, tags, custom metadata, dimensions, size, URL and publication status. ImageKit API: GET /v1/files/{fileId}/details.

file_id.description: The ImageKit fileId (the `fileId` field returned by imagekit_list_files).

tools.name: imagekit_get_file_metadata
tools.title: Get file metadata
tools.description: Get the EXIF, IPTC, XMP and technical metadata of one uploaded file. ImageKit API: GET /v1/files/{fileId}/metadata.

file_id.description: The ImageKit fileId (the `fileId` field returned by imagekit_list_files).

tools.name: imagekit_get_metadata_from_url
tools.title: Get metadata from a remote image URL
tools.description: Read the image metadata of a publicly reachable image URL without uploading it to the media library. ImageKit API: GET /v1/metadata?url=.

url.description: Public https URL of the image.

annotations.title: Get metadata from a remote image URL

tools.name: imagekit_list_file_versions
tools.title: List file versions
tools.description: List the earlier versions of one file. ImageKit API: GET /v1/files/{fileId}/versions.

file_id.description: The ImageKit fileId (the `fileId` field returned by imagekit_list_files).

tools.name: imagekit_list_custom_metadata_fields
tools.title: List custom metadata fields
tools.description: List the custom metadata fields defined for the account, with their types. Use the field names in imagekit_list_files searches. ImageKit API: GET /v1/customMetadataFields.

tools.name: imagekit_get_usage
tools.title: Get account usage
tools.description: Get bandwidth, storage, transformation and request usage for a date range. Needs a restricted key with account read access (standard keys do not include account management). ImageKit API: GET /v1/accounts/usage.

tools.name: imagekit_get_bulk_job_status
tools.title: Get bulk job status
tools.description: Check a bulk job, such as a folder copy or move, by its jobId. ImageKit API: GET /v1/bulkJobs/{jobId}.

job_id.description: The jobId returned by the bulk job request.

tools.name: imagekit_get_purge_status
tools.title: Get CDN purge status
tools.description: Check a CDN cache purge request by its requestId. ImageKit API: GET /v1/files/purge/{requestId}.

request_id.description: The requestId returned when the purge was requested.

tools.name: imagekit_upload_file
tools.title: Upload a file
tools.description: Upload an image or file to the media library from a public URL or a base64 string. Creates a new file each call (it does not overwrite by default). Upload host: POST https://upload.imagekit.io/api/v1/files/upload.

file.description: A public https URL of the file, or the file content as a base64 string.

file_name.description: File name to store, for example "shoe.jpg".

folder.description: Folder path to upload into, for example "/products/". Created if missing.

tags.description: Tags to add to the new file.

use_unique_file_name.description: Add a random suffix so the name is unique.

is_private_file.description: Restrict direct delivery to signed URLs.

tools.name: imagekit_update_file_details
tools.title: Update file tags or publication
tools.description: Replace the tags of one file, or publish or unpublish it. Tags sent here replace the existing tags. ImageKit API: PATCH /v1/files/{fileId}/details.

file_id.description: The ImageKit fileId (the `fileId` field returned by imagekit_list_files).

tags.description: New full tag list for the file. Replaces the existing tags.

is_published.description: true to publish the file, false to unpublish it.

include_file_versions.description: Also apply the publication change to all versions of the file.

tools.name: imagekit_add_tags
tools.title: Add tags to files
tools.description: Add tags to several files at once. Existing tags stay. Adding a tag twice has no extra effect. ImageKit API: POST /v1/files/addTags.

items.description: The ImageKit fileId (the `fileId` field returned by imagekit_list_files).

file_ids.description: fileIds of the files to tag (up to 100).

tools.name: imagekit_remove_tags
tools.title: Remove tags from files
tools.description: Remove tags from several files at once. Tags that are not present have no effect. ImageKit API: POST /v1/files/removeTags.

items.description: The ImageKit fileId (the `fileId` field returned by imagekit_list_files).

file_ids.description: fileIds of the files to untag (up to 100).

tools.name: imagekit_move_file
tools.title: Move a file to another folder
tools.description: Move one file to another folder. The file path changes, so existing links to the old path stop working. ImageKit API: POST /v1/files/move.

source_file_path.description: Full path of the file in the media library, for example "/products/shoe.jpg".

destination_path.description: Folder path in the media library, for example "/products/".

annotations.title: Move a file to another folder

tools.name: imagekit_rename_file
tools.title: Rename a file
tools.description: Rename one file. The file path changes, so existing links to the old name stop working. ImageKit API: PUT /v1/files/rename.

file_path.description: Full path of the file in the media library, for example "/products/shoe.jpg".

new_file_name.description: New file name only, for example "shoe-v2.jpg".

purge_cache.description: Also purge the CDN cache for the old URL.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ImageKit
prompts.description: What you can do with ImageKit here, with example requests to try.
